# StrategyEngine
> Free algorithmic forex trading strategy builder and backtester. Upload OHLC data, select technical indicators, optimise strategies with a genetic algorithm, and validate with Monte Carlo simulation.

## About
StrategyEngine is built on University of Sydney Master of Data Science research into autonomous rule-based forex trading systems, supervised by Dr. Matloob Khushi. It is free and open source.

## What it does
- Accepts any OHLC CSV (any forex pair, any timeframe)
- Brute-force trains 16 technical indicator parameters on training data
- Uses a genetic algorithm (GAMSSR fitness function) to find optimal rule weight combinations
- Validates strategies with Monte Carlo simulation (price noise, bootstrap, time shuffle, parameter perturbation)
- Saves winning strategies that meet user-defined return, Sharpe ratio, drawdown, and MC pass rate thresholds
- Runs continuously until stopped, accumulating winners

## Technical indicators supported
1. Simple Moving Average crossover (MA x MA)
2. Exponential MA x Simple MA crossover
3. EMA x EMA crossover
4. Double EMA (DEMA) x MA crossover
5. DEMA x DEMA crossover
6. Triple EMA (TEMA) x MA crossover
7. Stochastic Oscillator x Stochastic Signal Line
8. Vortex Indicator positive x negative
9. Ichimoku Cloud (Span A x Span B)
10. RSI x single threshold
11. CCI x single threshold
12. RSI dual band (overbought/oversold)
13. CCI dual band (overbought/oversold)
14. Keltner Channel breakout
15. Donchian Channel breakout
16. Bollinger Bands breakout

## Research foundation
Based on: Rule-based forex trading system — University of Sydney, Master of Data Science capstone project. The system uses 16 crossover-based trading rules combined via genetic algorithm weight optimisation using the GAMSSR (Genetic Algorithm Maximum Sharpe-Sortino Ratio) fitness function.
